notice.privacy.bookmark: When you add a bookmark with a web address, the server opens that address to read the page's name and picture.
notice.privacy.cookies: One cookie keeps you signed in. Your browser also remembers a few display choices on this device. There is no advertising and no tracking.
notice.privacy.kept: Your email. Your name and picture, if you add them. Your password, kept in a scrambled form that cannot be turned back into the password. And everything you add: orders, receipts, vendors, categories, bookmarks and budgets.
notice.privacy.lead: What Spendly keeps about you, and where it goes.
notice.privacy.mail: Links to confirm your email or to reset your password are sent to your email address, through the email service this server uses.
notice.privacy.receiptRate: If the receipt is in another currency, the receipt's currency, your own currency and the receipt's date are sent to frankfurter.dev to find that day's exchange rate. Nothing else from the receipt is sent there.
notice.privacy.receiptScan: When you scan a receipt, its picture is sent to Anthropic, the company that makes Claude, so the text on it can be read.
notice.privacy.where: In one database on the server that runs this copy of Spendly. The person who looks after that server can open the database.
notice.terms.account: The account is for your own records. Keep your password to yourself. If someone else learns it, change it in Settings.
notice.terms.add: The orders, receipts and other records you add are yours. You can change or delete them at any time.
notice.terms.lead: The rules for an account on this copy of Spendly.
notice.terms.who: This copy of Spendly runs on a server that a person set up and looks after. That person decides who can have an account here. If they gave you terms of their own, those apply too.
